encounters.title: The Lost Cartographer
encounters.description: A faint distress signal pulses from a debris field — not a standard beacon, but something older, stranger. Between shattered asteroids, a tiny fairy vessel spins helplessly, its wings of light flickering. Inside, a fairy clutches rolls of shimmering star charts, eyes wide with panic.

dialogue_steps.speaker: fairy_cartographer
dialogue_steps.text: Oh! Oh thank the starlight! I thought I was done for! Those goblin scrappers chased me into this wretched field and my navigation crystal shattered!

dialogue_steps.speaker: aristotle
dialogue_steps.text: Easy there, little one. You're safe now. What's a fairy doing out here in the Fringe?

dialogue_steps.speaker: fairy_cartographer
dialogue_steps.text: I am Pip, cartographer of the Fairy Realms! I map the hidden places — the treasure caches, the lost ships, the crystal gardens that no one else can find. I was charting this sector when those brutes attacked!

dialogue_steps.speaker: fairy_cartographer
dialogue_steps.text: Please, Captain, take me aboard! I'll share everything I've mapped. Secret locations across every region — treasures, abandoned ships, crystal hoards hidden away for centuries!

choices.text: "Welcome aboard, Pip. A cartographer is worth their weight in crystals."
"I don't run a charity. What's in it for me, specifically?"
"Sorry, little one. I've got my own problems."

dialogue_steps.speaker: fairy_cartographer
dialogue_steps.text: Oh, wonderful! Wonderful! Here — look at these charts! I've marked every hidden cache, every lost vessel, every crystal garden I've ever found. They'll appear on your star maps now. You won't regret this, Captain!

dialogue_steps.speaker: aristotle
dialogue_steps.text: Star charts showing hidden locations across the sector? Now that's what I call a proper rescue reward.

dialogue_steps.speaker: fairy_cartographer
dialogue_steps.text: I — well — I have crystals! A few, anyway. And my charts! They show hidden treasures across every region. Lost ships full of salvage, crystal hoards buried in asteroids... Please, it's all I have!

dialogue_steps.speaker: aristotle
dialogue_steps.text: Charts showing hidden treasure? Now you're speaking my language.

choices.text: "The charts are payment enough. Get aboard."
"Charts AND the crystals. A cat's got to eat."

dialogue_steps.speaker: fairy_cartographer
dialogue_steps.text: Thank you, Captain! The hidden locations are now marked on your star charts. May the starlight guide you to every one of them!

dialogue_steps.speaker: fairy_cartographer
dialogue_steps.text: No! Wait! Please! I'll — I'll die out here! The goblins will come back! Captain! CAPTAIN!
